gloss: to bring near, to let approach

definitions.gloss: to bring near, to move closer

examples.japanese: {耳|みみ}を{近|ちか}づけて{聞|き}いた。
examples.english: I brought my ear closer and listened.

notes:
{近|ちか}づける means to bring something or someone closer.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {近|ちか}づく (intransitive, to approach)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {顔|かお}を{近|ちか}づける: to bring one's face closer
- {耳|みみ}を{近|ちか}づける: to bring one's ear closer (to listen)
- {火|ひ}を{近|ちか}づけない: not bring fire near
- {距離|きょり}を{近|ちか}づける: to close the distance

ASPECT (ている):
{近|ちか}づけている indicates ongoing action of bringing closer.

RELATED:
- {近|ちか}づく: to approach (intransitive)
- {近|ちか}い: close, near (adjective)
- {離|はな}す: to separate (opposite action)
